narration_fil: Noong huli, nalaman nina Mang Ernesto at BHW Vlanche na awtomatikong kasama ang bawat Pilipinong mamamayan sa National Health Insurance Program. Iyon ang unang kahon sa apat na pagbabagong pinili ng gabay sa UHC: **PhilHealth inclusion, outpatient consultation, pagpili ng primary care provider, at mas maayos na referral**. Marami pang pagbabagong nakalista sa BHW Reference Manual; itong apat ang sinusundan natin sa kuwento. Ngayon, ang tanong ni Mang Ernesto ay: ‘Saan ako magsisimula, at paano kung kailangan ko ng ibang serbisyo?’ Hindi huhulaan ni Vlanche ang sagot para sa kanilang barangay.
narration_en: Last time, Mang Ernesto and BHW Vlanche learned that every Filipino citizen is automatically included in the National Health Insurance Program. That is the first box in the UHC guide’s selected four-change chain: **PhilHealth inclusion, outpatient consultation, choosing a primary care provider, and a better referral system**. The BHW Reference Manual lists more changes; this story follows these four. Now Mang Ernesto asks, ‘Where do I start, and what if I need another service?’ Vlanche will not guess the answer for their barangay.

display_fil:

Tiyakin ang serbisyo, clinic, at proseso.
display_en:
Outpatient ≠ hospital admission.
YAKAP has specified benefits and rules.
Check the service, clinic, and steps.
narration_fil: Ang outpatient ay pangangalagang hindi nangangailangan ng pagpapaospital, gaya ng konsultasyon sa primary care. Saklaw ng kasalukuyang PhilHealth YAKAP primary care package ang mga partikular na serbisyo sa ilalim ng mga tuntunin nito. Hindi ibig sabihin nito na makukuha ang bawat pagsusuri, gamot, o konsulta sa kahit anong pasilidad. Tatanungin ni Vlanche kung anong serbisyo ang kailangan ni Mang Ernesto at titiyakin sa PhilHealth o health team kung sakop ito, sa aling accredited clinic, at ano ang kailangang proseso. Ang health professional ang magtatakda ng angkop na klinikal na pangangalaga.
narration_en: Outpatient care does not require hospital admission; a primary care consultation is one example. PhilHealth’s current YAKAP primary care package covers specified services under its rules. That does not mean every test, medicine, or consultation is available at any facility. Vlanche asks which service Mang Ernesto is seeking, then checks with PhilHealth or the health team whether it is covered, at which accredited clinic, and what steps apply. A health professional decides the appropriate clinical care.

heading_fil: Alin ang napiling primary care clinic?
heading_en: Which primary care clinic was chosen?
display_fil:
May pagpili ng primary care clinic.
Kasama sa PhilHealth ≠ may napili nang clinic.
Tulungan siyang alamin ang mga opsiyon.
display_en:
The resident chooses a primary care clinic.
PhilHealth inclusion ≠ clinic selected.
Help confirm the available choices.
narration_fil: Sa ilalim ng UHC Act, dapat makapili at makapagparehistro ang bawat Pilipino sa pampubliko o pribadong primary care provider. Sa kasalukuyang patakaran ng PhilHealth, may proseso para sa pagpili ng accredited YAKAP primary care clinic at unang patient encounter. Hindi awtomatikong ibig sabihin ng PhilHealth inclusion na napili na ang clinic. Itatanong ni Vlanche kung may napili na si Mang Ernesto; kung hindi niya alam, tutulungan siyang itanong sa RHU, PhilHealth, o health team ang mga kasalukuyang pagpipilian at paraan ng pagpili. Si Mang Ernesto ang pipili; hindi pipili si Vlanche para sa kanya at hindi magpapangalan ng clinic na hindi pa natiyak.
narration_en: Under the UHC Act, every Filipino is to choose and register with a public or private primary care provider. PhilHealth’s current rules provide a process for selecting an accredited YAKAP primary care clinic and completing a first patient encounter. Automatic PhilHealth inclusion does not mean a clinic has already been selected. Vlanche asks whether Mang Ernesto has chosen one; if he is unsure, she helps him ask the RHU, PhilHealth, or health team about current choices and how to select. Mang Ernesto chooses. Vlanche does not choose for him or name a clinic she has not confirmed.

display_fil:

BHW → pag-ugnay at pagsunod sa tagubilin.
display_en:
Clinician → clinical decision.
Health team → local pathway and contact.
BHW → coordination and follow-through.
narration_fil: Layunin ng UHC ang mas magkakaugnay na serbisyo, kabilang ang pag-aayos ng dating hiwa-hiwalay na mga programang pangkalusugan at mas maayos na paglipat sa ibang antas ng pangangalaga. Ngunit maaaring may sariling referral protocol ang lokal na pamahalaan. Ang doktor, nurse, o midwife ang gagabay sa pasyente at magpapasya sa klinikal na pangangailangan at angkop na pagre-refer. Ang tungkulin ni Vlanche ay alamin sa kanila ang kasalukuyang lokal na contact, paraan ng pakikipag-ugnayan, at tagubilin para sa residente. Hindi siya magpapasya kung anong kondisyon ang dapat dalhin sa ospital o kung saang pasilidad ito tatanggapin.
narration_en: UHC aims to connect services better, including reorganizing previously separate health programs and improving movement between levels of care. Local governments may have their own referral protocols. A doctor, nurse, or midwife guides the patient and decides the clinical need and appropriate referral. Vlanche’s role is to ask them for the current local contact, communication method, and instructions for the resident. She does not decide which condition needs hospital care or which facility will receive the patient.

heading_fil: Ang susunod na hakbang ni Vlanche
display_fil:
Tiyakin: napiling clinic.
Tiyakin: outpatient benefit at hakbang.
Kung may referral: kunin ang lokal na tagubilin.
display_en:
Confirm: selected clinic.
Confirm: outpatient benefit and steps.
If referred: get local instructions.
narration_fil: Sinabi ni Vlanche kay Mang Ernesto: ‘Alamin muna natin kung may napili na kayong primary care clinic. Itatanong din natin sa health team kung anong outpatient benefit at hakbang ang naaangkop sa inyong konsultasyon. Kung sabihin ng clinician na kailangan ng referral, hihingin natin ang lokal na proseso at contact.’ Sa isang maliit na tala, isinulat niya ang tatlong kailangang kumpirmahin: **clinic at pagpili; benepisyo at paraan ng paggamit; referral contact at tagubilin kung kailangan**. Hindi niya ipinangakong mayroon nang lahat ng serbisyo sa barangay. Ang mga hindi pa nasasagot ay dadalhin niya sa midwife o RHU.
narration_en: Vlanche tells Mang Ernesto, ‘Let us first find out whether you have chosen a primary care clinic. We will also ask the health team which outpatient benefit and steps apply to your consultation. If a clinician says a referral is needed, we will get the local process and contact.’ On a small note, she writes the three things to confirm: **clinic and selection; benefit and how to use it; referral contact and instructions if needed**. She does not promise that every service is already available in the barangay. She takes unanswered questions to the midwife or RHU.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi alam ni Mang Ernesto ang napili niyang primary care clinic at nagtatanong siya tungkol sa posibleng referral. Ano ang pinakamainam na susunod na hakbang ni Vlanche?
check.prompt_en: Mang Ernesto does not know which primary care clinic he selected and asks about a possible referral. What is Vlanche’s best next step?

options.fil: Tulungan siyang tiyakin sa RHU o PhilHealth ang napili o mapipiling clinic at outpatient process; kung kailangan ng referral ayon sa clinician, kunin sa health team ang lokal na tagubilin.
options.en: Help him confirm his selected or available clinic and outpatient process with the RHU or PhilHealth; if a clinician recommends referral, get the local instructions from the health team.

options.fil: Pumili ng clinic para sa kanya at sabihin na roon siya dapat magpunta kahit hindi pa natiyak ang status nito.
options.en: Choose a clinic for him and tell him to go there without confirming its status.

options.fil: Magpasya kung kailangan niyang ma-refer at pumili agad ng ospital batay sa hinala ni Vlanche.
options.en: Decide whether he needs referral and choose a hospital based on Vlanche’s guess.

check.feedback_fil: Tinutulungan ng BHW ang residente sa pagpili at paggamit ng serbisyo matapos tiyakin ang lokal na impormasyon. Ang clinician ang nagpapasya sa referral; ang health team ang magbibigay ng lokal na tagubilin.
check.feedback_en: The BHW helps the resident navigate clinic selection and benefits after confirming local information. The clinician decides on referral; the health team provides local instructions.

narration_fil: Hindi pa alam ni Mang Ernesto kung may napili na siyang primary care clinic. Nagtanong din siya kung saan siya pupunta kung magrekomenda ng referral ang clinician. Ano ang dapat gawin ni Vlanche ngayon?
narration_en: Mang Ernesto is unsure whether he has selected a primary care clinic. He also asks where to go if a clinician recommends a referral. What should Vlanche do now?
